nodes.name: Fetch Launch Record
nodes.notes: Launch row contract (ruled 2026-09-08): Client, Table (must be "Companies", by name, no default), View (by name, required, no default), Tag. Launch Params refuses anything else before a paid call.

nodes.name: Stamp Running
nodes.notes: First thing the launch door does, ahead of every guard: the row carries the Execution ID and link from the moment the POST lands, so a refusal or a crash can always be read back on the row the Operator launched. It passes the record through, so Resolve Base still reads fields.Client off it.

nodes.name: Sub Trigger
nodes.notes: Event entry: one item carrying the same keys as a launch row (Client, Table, View, Tag, and Domains for the insert doors). This is how an insert door calls this machine after landing: Table "Companies", View "Not Sourced", Domains = what it landed. No launch row, no Running stamp; Log Run creates the run row on Execution ID at the close.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Event-Row.js

nodes.name: Resolve Base
nodes.notes: A launch row with no Client link used to kill the run right here: $json.fields.Client[0] threw inside the node before Launch Params could name the refusal, so the row got nothing back. It now asks for "recMISSING" and keeps going; Launch Params reads the answer defensively and refuses with the reason.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Launch-Params.js

nodes.name: Launch OK?
nodes.notes: The refusal gate. Launch Params names a bad launch row instead of throwing; false here means refused, and Build Refusal closes the row as Failed with the reason before anything is read or paid for.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Find-Tables.js

nodes.name: Read Companies View
nodes.notes: The Companies view (by name, required on the launch row) is the whole scope: every company in it is asked, no cap. A view that does not exist crashes here, before any paid call, into the Error Logger.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Pick-Companies.js

nodes.name: AT List Views
nodes.notes: After the four lanes closed and the companies were stamped: read the base meta again; the email door fires once if People carries a view named exactly "Not Waterfalled".

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Find-Waterfall-View.js

nodes.name: Fire Waterfall
nodes.notes: The one email hand-off, once per run after the last lane: Enrich Emails record door, People view Not Waterfalled. Not awaited; it writes its own rows.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Build-Log.js
@@file:nodes/Build-Refusal.js

nodes.name: Build Refusal
nodes.notes: A badly filled launch row closes here as Failed with the named reason and the execution link, on the same row Stamp Running opened. Refusals are expected outcomes and are logged as such; the Error Logger still owns real crashes.

nodes.name: Get DNC Domains
nodes.notes: The client's table named DNC (resolved by name in Find Tables), read once for every lane. No DNC table: the read errors quietly and nothing is dropped.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Plan-Companies.js

nodes.name: Plan Companies
nodes.notes: Cap and floor per company from the Employees value on our row, plus the DNC list: the one plan every lane receives.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Blitz-Lane-Input.js

nodes.name: Run Blitz Lane
nodes.notes: The Blitz lane, once for the whole run, awaited: it chunks and paces itself and writes People through Enrich Contacts Writer chunk by chunk. Lanes run in priority order so first writer wins. A crash comes back as an error item and is logged; never retried.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Blitz-Progress.js

nodes.name: Stamp Blitz Progress
nodes.notes: The launch row refreshed after the Blitz lane closed: Status Running, the running funnel, Tally; on Execution ID (created here on an event run).

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/GetLeads-Lane-Input.js

nodes.name: Run GetLeads Lane
nodes.notes: The GetLeads lane, once for the whole run, awaited: it chunks and paces itself and writes People through Enrich Contacts Writer chunk by chunk. Lanes run in priority order so first writer wins. A crash comes back as an error item and is logged; never retried.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/GetLeads-Progress.js

nodes.name: Stamp GetLeads Progress
nodes.notes: The launch row refreshed after the GetLeads lane closed: Status Running, the running funnel, Tally; on Execution ID (created here on an event run).

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/QuickEnrich-Progress.js

nodes.name: Stamp QuickEnrich Progress
nodes.notes: The launch row refreshed after the QuickEnrich lane closed: Status Running, the running funnel, Tally; on Execution ID (created here on an event run).

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Relevant-Filters.js

nodes.name: Relevant Filters
nodes.notes: The Supersoniq gate: one formula per 100 domains for the relevant People rows at the run domains.

nodes.name: Read Relevant People
nodes.notes: Relevant people already held at the run domains, read after the free lanes wrote; Supersoniq Lane Input asks Supersoniq only for companies below 5. A base without a relevance rule has none, so every company passes.

nodes.name: Run Supersoniq Lane
nodes.notes: The Supersoniq lane, once for the whole run, awaited: it chunks and paces itself and writes People through Enrich Contacts Writer chunk by chunk. Lanes run in priority order so first writer wins. A crash comes back as an error item and is logged; never retried.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Supersoniq-Progress.js

nodes.name: Stamp Supersoniq Progress
nodes.notes: The launch row refreshed after the Supersoniq lane closed: Status Running, the running funnel, Tally; on Execution ID (created here on an event run).

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Stamp-Rows.js

nodes.name: Stamp Companies
nodes.notes: The one Companies writer: Contacts Pulled At = now on every company of the run, PATCH by record id, ten per request, 200 ms apart, no retry; a request that is not 2xx counts its ten as stamp errors.
